description: One pull request per repository for everything non-breaking, rather than one per dependency. Merging them singly means every merge rebases the others and restarts their checks: one run over an organisation of 34 repositories updated 109 branches and merged 2. Grouped, a repository needs one round of checks instead of dozens.

Never auto-merge the Go toolchain, and never let it ride in somebody else's group. A rule that says automerge:false for one dependency is defeated by grouping, because Renovate decides automerge per BRANCH: go 1.27.0 rode into seven repositories inside a branch called renovate/github-actions, whose other dependency was actions/setup-go. Ungrouped, it gets a branch of its own and this setting governs it. It matters because go1.27.0 miscompiles on loong64 (golang/go#81000, bisected on real hardware to 3fdac6780b): go-gfx/gfx fails that lane and stayed open only because the lane failed, which is the CI gate holding rather than this rule. A repository without such a lane sees nothing.

Dockerfile and compose files under testdata are fixtures, not build inputs: build's parser tests compare against BuildKit's own Dockerfiles verbatim (build#7/#8 rewrote their FROM lines and turned the tests red), and compose's testdata/lab/compose.yaml names localhost:5000/db, which no registry can answer (a standing 'Package lookup failures' warning). Scoped by manager and path with a packageRule rather than a blanket ignorePaths, because ignorePaths is not mergeable (a repository's own list replaces the preset's) and testdata also holds real Go modules (testdata/wasm/*/go.mod) that should keep being updated.

Vendored trees are updated by re-vendoring, not by Renovate: shell's third_party/mvdan-sh carries its own workflows and go.mod (shell#5/#6 and six rate-limited docker/* majors came from it). Disabled for every manager by path.

Node 26 hangs the Playwright driver install: relay#11 and gpu#9 both stalled in the step that installs the driver and browsers (relay: in_progress 4h51m, a rerun 22+ min, while node 22 on main finishes the job in under 15 minutes; gpu: 30 minutes after Chromium reached 100%). Hold Node at 22 in the repositories that run Playwright; lift when the driver install is shown to work on a newer Node.
